description: Edit documents and project files while making every change understandable and reviewable by people.

defaultPrompt: Edit this file and make every change easy for a human to review.
Revise this document while preserving its layout and provide a change report.
Compare these original and edited files and show exactly what changed.
interface.longDescription: A workflow skill for ChatGPT and Codex to edit files carefully, preserve layout where possible, and deliver reviewable outputs with change summaries, diffs, redlines, or comments. It explains format-specific limits instead of pretending every file format supports tracked changes.

name: visible-file-editor
